_what_this_is: The three day-one Etsy listings as structured data, so the tag and title limits can be checked by build/listings/check_etsy.py instead of counted by hand. The prose that goes in the description field lives in MARKETPLACE-LISTINGS.md, which is what Phil pastes from. Two more were written, priced and readied, then withdrawn: L3-entryway (2026-09-09) and L2-kitchen (2026-09-23), both for the same reason, sold content ops/generated_products.py already excludes from the site's own paid catalogue because a free deck covers it. See MARKETPLACE-LISTINGS.md section 3.1 for the withdrawal notes.
_limits_note: Etsy returned HTTP 403 to every automated request on 2026-09-03, so no limit below was verified today. 140 characters for the title and 20 for a tag are the limits the form has long enforced; the copy here sits well inside both, so if the real limits are tighter the copy still fits.

_shop.note: Shop name availability cannot be checked without an account. Etsy allows one free name change later, so take whichever of these is free rather than stalling on the first choice.
